objective: Implement remediation Steps 5-8 of the exhaustive sovereign code review: web-surface security, storage correctness, wire-or-delete dead features, and typing hygiene.
tech_stack: Go 1.27, CGO_ENABLED=0, modernc.org/sqlite (pure-Go), zitadel/oidc/v3, go-webauthn, minio-go, bluesky-social/indigo, golang.org/x/crypto. Single-binary server owning identity/auth/storage/protocol adapters.
constraints: TDD mandatory: write failing test first, then implement (RED-GREEN-REFACTOR).
All gates must pass before commit: lint, vet, go test ./... -race, coverage >=80%, vulncheck.
No CGO_ENABLED=1 dependency ever. Pure-Go SQLite (modernc.org/sqlite), not mattn/go-sqlite3.
Fail closed, defense in depth. Untrusted input parsed with fail-closed posture.
Tenant-scoping: every store query and route touching tenant data scoped by tenant_id. Never trust client-supplied tenant/account ID without checking authenticated principal.
Adapters live in internal/wiring/, not inline in server/.
SSRF-sensitive code must resolve DNS and reject loopback/private/link-local/multicast/cloud-metadata ranges, cap redirects, cap body size, strict timeout, run in background not sync request path.
New public endpoints need: explicit content-type, cache headers, explicit 404 for unknown tenant, behavior on unpublished/revoked/expired.
New authenticated endpoints need IDOR test proving account cannot read/write other tenants' data.
Coverage gate is 80% per-package and total (enforced by scripts/coverage-gate.sh).
Narrow, commented .golangci.yml exclusions only for justified findings.
License-compatible with GPL-3.0-or-later; no new deps without justification.
PII redaction: never log key material, tokens, full proof payloads at info level.
conventions: Package doc comment at top of primary file in each package.
Error style: lowercase, prefixed "<pkg>: message", wrapped with fmt.Errorf("...: %w", err). No panics in request-path code.
Interface satisfaction assertions: var _ SomeInterface = (*Impl)(nil) after type.
Tests colocated (foo.go + foo_test.go), table-driven preferred, real fixtures over mocks.
Security-relevant packages need explicit negative tests (malformed input, oversized input, private-key rejection, SSRF targets, IDOR, concurrency on shared state).
E2E tests live in internal/server/e2e_test.go + e2e_harness_test.go — extend harness.
Run task lint test vet before done.
#nosec inline comments for justified gosec exclusions; .codacy.yml engines.gosec.exclude_paths for Codacy-specific (Codacy gosec ignores inline #nosec).

STEP5_web_surface.B9: CSRF: /panel/tos, /panel/passkey, /panel/profile accept cookie-authed POSTs with no CSRF token / Origin validation. SameSite=Lax insufficient (sibling subdomains).
STEP5_web_surface.B10: PasskeySetup set true on any authed POST, no credential verification. Derive from ListCredentials or set only in RegisterFinish.
STEP5_web_surface.B2: SMTP header injection: internal/admin/users.go:42-46,79-86 + internal/mail/mail.go:96-106. email interpolated into To: with only TrimSpace, no CRLF rejection / RFC 5321 validation.
STEP5_web_surface.B11: WebAuthn endpoints trust client-supplied handle: internal/auth/webauthn_handler.go, mounted unauthenticated server.go:274-277. RegisterFinish re-binds challenge; handle enumeration.
STEP5_web_surface.B12: IndieAuth: internal/server/indieauth.go. state reused as authorization code, codes not invalidated, no consent, string-concat redirect, me from token request, session not deleted.
STEP5_web_surface.B14: No rate limiting or request-size limits anywhere. Unbounded io.ReadAll on PUT (remotestorage, solid/ldp), no MaxBytesReader on forms. No IdleTimeout/ReadHeaderTimeout on http.Server.
STEP5_web_surface.B13: AdminGuard bearer-only but handlers render HTML forms -> unusable. Pick session+cookie+CSRF or API-only JSON.

STEP6_storage.D1: fs.go Put not crash-safe (no temp+rename+fsync), metadata write unsynced, Get ignores sidecar errors, List returns empty content types, ctx ignored.
STEP6_storage.D2: fs.go + prefixed.go path traversal / symlink handling: path.Join keys, need filepath.Clean + prefix verify + os.OpenInRoot (Go 1.24+) + reject control chars.
STEP6_storage.D3: s3.go Put buffers entire object in memory (io.ReadAll before PutObject). Stream with size=-1 or enforce MaxBytesReader.
STEP6_storage.D4: NewS3 does network I/O + bucket creation during construction with context.Background(), no timeout. Accept ctx, dial timeout, opt-in bucket creation.
STEP6_storage.B1: S3 Secure never propagated from config (defaults false -> plaintext HTTP). Add secure (default true) to server.S3Config, reject https:// scheme in endpoint, allow_insecure override.

STEP7_wire_or_delete.A3: Backup config is a no-op (Apply just logs, returns 200 'saved'). Scheduler never constructed. Wire: persist config, construct Destination, start Scheduler, surface Status. Or return 501.
STEP7_wire_or_delete.A4: atproto PDS wired with nil Backend/RepoFactory/SigningKey -> 6/8 XRPC methods broken. Wire backendFor, per-tenant RepoFactory under DataDir, SigningKey.
STEP7_wire_or_delete.A6: atproto records capped at 255 bytes (fixed 0x58 CBOR header). Encode as proper DAG-CBOR maps via indigo/ipld-go-ipld-prime.
STEP7_wire_or_delete.A7: atproto getProfile never resolves DIDs (dead branch). Add GetTenantByDID or delete branch + reject DID input.
STEP7_wire_or_delete.A8: Audit entry IDs collide (resource-action-RFC3339Nano), Actor set to e.Action not admin principal. Random ID + thread authenticated admin subject.
STEP7_wire_or_delete.B5: WAC (internal/protocols/solid/wac.go) dead code. Wired ACLChecker permits all unauth reads by design. Wire WACChecker fail-closed, public access opt-in via acl:agentClass foaf:Agent.
STEP7_wire_or_delete.B6: Proof verification never wired (no caller). Verifier SSRF: hostFromURL manual parse, DNS resolve before request (rebinding window), no redirect-hop revalidation, single Read no status/content-type check, substring matching.
STEP7_wire_or_delete.C1: Dead packages/types: internal/setup, internal/licenses, internal/keys (pgp/ssh), internal/protocols/chatfederation (localpart), activitypub sigverify, solid.WACChecker, backup.Scheduler, ipfspin.NewPSAClient, moderation.ToSGate, moderation.MemoryAuditLog. Each: wire, delete, or document not-wired.
STEP7_wire_or_delete.C2: ToSGate exempts /admin/tos which doesn't exist. Align exempt path with real /panel/tos.
STEP7_wire_or_delete.E1: OIDC SQLStore: auth requests/codes in-memory only, DeleteAuthRequest leaks code->ID map, CreateAccessToken no metadata, TerminateSession no-op, userinfo/introspection empty. Persist with TTL, implement userinfo/introspection/session termination.

STEP8_typing.G: 36 'any' occurrences. map[string]any response literals -> named structs (didDocHandler, xrpc_server.go). Annotate justified external-boundary any. Add nosniff + Cache-Control headers, surface encoder errors.

prior_decisions: USER DIRECTIVE (2026-08-28, supersedes admin-auth fork): The entire application must expose a REST API (JSON) covering all admin AND user functionality. HTML pages become thin clients that call the API via fetch(). This is the authoritative auth-model for B13 and the panel: admin routes (users, backup, moderation/takedown, ipfs) and user routes (tos, passkey, profile) expose JSON endpoints; HTML forms are replaced by JS fetch() clients hitting those endpoints.
admin is INSTANCE-scoped (Step 3 T-critic1) — first user of any tenant becomes instance admin via single atomic INSERT CASE.
Client secrets argon2id (m=65536,t=3,p=1,16B salt,32B key), max 128B, sentinel '!invalidated-by-migration-v5'.
Refresh tokens 30-day expiry + rotation/reuse detection (family_id/rotated_at, migration v6); existing tokens survive grace.
Strict config: yaml KnownFields + viper ErrorUnused. Removed keys: identity_host, sqlite.*, tls.*, atproto.*, backup.*. Kept ipfs.enabled, audience, open_registrations.
